subject: Qorion Energy — Exec workshop Thursday conflict; proposed hybrid pivot
messages:

Subject: Qorion Energy — Exec workshop Thursday (final logistics)

Hi Elena / Tom,

Looking forward to hosting the executive workshop on Thursday, 3/18. Quick logistics:

- Arrival: please aim to arrive at 9:30am for coffee/networking; we’ll start at 10:00am.
- Morning: CTO briefing + product deep dive (10:00–12:00).
- Lunch: 12:00–1:00 (we’ve reserved the private dining room).
- Exec strategy session: 2:00–4:00pm (this is the session your CEO had flagged).
- Location: Redwood HQ — West Conference Center, 3rd floor. See attached Venue_Map_SF_West.pdf.

Attached is an updated agenda (Updated_Agenda_v2.pdf). Can you confirm the final attendee list and whether the CEO will join in person or remotely? Also let us know if procurement will want a separate slot for contracting items.

Happy to make any last-minute adjustments — we can also provision an AV setup if remote participation is needed.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-03-18T08:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Qorion Energy — Exec workshop Thursday (final logistics)

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the note and the updated agenda. Quick heads up: our CEO’s board was just moved into a conflict window on Thursday afternoon, so he can’t commit to an in-person 2:00pm exec block.

We have two asks:
1) Can the exec strategy session be moved to Friday morning (3/19) — we understand this is short notice and it may not work for your team.
2) If moving is not possible, can you run the 2:00pm exec block virtually (we’d join via a secure dial-in) and have an on-site facilitator handle the in-room participants?

Procurement (cc’d) will still want to cover contract items; Tom can confirm whether he’ll stay on for the virtual session. We’re also concerned about AV — do you have a reliable vendor / backup?

Appreciate any flexibility. If you want to call, I’m available this morning between 9:30–11:00.

Best,
Elena
VP of Strategy
Qorion Energy
elena.morales@qorionenergy.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Qorion Energy — Exec workshop Thursday (internal options)

Vanessa — looping in Sean and Monica for quick ops coordination. Elena just notified us that the CEO’s board conflict impacts the 2pm exec block. Options:

A) Move the exec block to Friday 3/19 morning (logistics: rebook rooms, coordinate travel adjustments for our facilitator). Pros: preserves in-person experience. Cons: customer exec travel changes; risk some attendees can’t move.

B) Keep Thursday schedule intact for morning in-person sessions and switch the 2pm exec session to fully virtual (we provide remote facilitation, recording, and a dedicated producer). Pros: minimizes travel churn. Cons: reduced in-person engagement for exec block.

C) Hybrid split: run a small, in-room panel + AV bridge for remote execs. Pros: keeps some IRL energy. Cons: requires reliable AV vendor and a producer on-site; more complexity and marginal cost.

My recommendation: Option B to avoid rebooking flights/hotel on short notice. Sean — can you confirm AV vendor availability and pricing for an on-site producer/bridge if we need C? Monica — if we go virtual for the 2pm exec session, can you provide the remote facilitator and pre-brief materials?

If Elena confirms by 5pm today, we can lock rooms and run Option B.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Enterprise Sales Operations | marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Qorion Energy — Exec workshop Thursday (final logistics)

Elena / Tom — thanks for the quick update and apologies for the scramble. After internal ops sync, here’s our proposed plan to avoid moving the entire workshop:

1) Keep Thursday morning in-person as scheduled (CTO briefing and product deep dive).
2) Run the 2:00–4:00pm exec strategy session as a virtual session (Option B) with these accommodations:
   - Redwood will provide a dedicated remote facilitator (Monica) and a producer to manage the bridge and recording.
   - We’ll stage a closed-room dial-in so your CEO can join remotely without a distracting lobby presence.
   - We’ll cover the incremental AV/producer cost for this session.
   - We’ll send a 30-minute pre-brief to all exec attendees and circulate a short pre-read and slide deck.

I’ve attached a slimmed agenda that reflects the Friday contingency and the Thursday virtual option (Updated_Agenda_v2.pdf). Also attached Venue_Map_SF_West.pdf and a quick travel itinerary stub for your team (Travel_Itinerary_stub.txt) so coordinators can confirm arrivals.

If this plan works, please confirm by 5:00pm PT tonight so we can finalize AV and catering. If you need a full in-person exec session, our fallback is Friday 3/19 at 10:00am — we’d need confirmation by 11:00am tomorrow to rebook rooms and logistics.
